payload.title: a cli fit for strangers
payload.body: The real want is a first-run experience a stranger trusts, not a framework swap. Today the CLI (cac + picocolors) leads with corpus-author commands (init, add, compose, project, optimize, catalog, explain) that an end user never needs. Split the surface by audience: a consumer path (install, upgrade with the relaunch guidance, uninstall, a health check) shown first, and the corpus-author commands grouped apart. Use the modern standard pieces: commander for commands, @clack/prompts for the install wizard, picocolors for color; one command framework, not two.
